baseline_models.mechanism: The clothing branch and the recompense-as-return branch converge: action returns not as abstract credit but as a condition worn by its recipients.

activation_trace.role: Clothing and covering give the return a bodily, inhabitable form.
Recompense returning to its worker supplies the reciprocal direction of the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists clothing and then separately praises reward.
changed_reading.after: Clothing and reward form one return circuit: righteous action comes back as an enveloping condition the recipients inhabit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Gardens, running rivers beneath, green garments, and a good `مُرْتَفَق` form one environmental sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A tree-hidden garden is fed by continuous movement below; durable provision, flourishing greenness, and usable repose make the place a self-renewing support system.

activation_trace.role: The tree-hidden garden supplies the sheltered living enclosure.
Continuous coursing supplies the environmental motion.
Enduring provision turns motion into maintained supply.
A river cutting through ground supplies the water-bearing channel.
Lush ease and flourishing make the green clothing register environmental vitality.
Usable benefit makes the habitat continuously serviceable, not merely scenic.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a beautiful static destination.
changed_reading.after: It depicts living infrastructure: sheltered growth, continuously routed provision, embodied flourishing, and enduring use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bracelets, garments, reclining, couches, and `مُرْتَفَقًا` move from the body's surface to what bears its weight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concentric and load-bearing layers move from bracelet around hand, to garment around body, to couch under body; gentleness and utility complete an ergonomics of safety.

activation_trace.role: The bracelet literally encircles the hand as the innermost fitted boundary.
Clothing supplies the body's covering layer.
Reclining transfers bodily weight onto a support.
The furnished couch supplies the stable external bearer.
Gentleness names the non-coercive quality of the whole arrangement.
Elbow and leaning support make the closing place-word bodily concrete.

changed_reading.before: Jewelry, clothing, and furniture are separate luxury goods.
changed_reading.after: They form a nested support system that fits, covers, bears, and gently settles the rewarded body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning against letting the eyes cross beyond worshippers toward worldly adornment is followed by granted gold, clothing, and ornament; beauty is relocated from a rival object of desire to a received consequence of rightly held desire.

activation_trace.role: Repeated willing supplies the motivational force whose object changes.
The looking eye supplies the channel that must be disciplined.
Wearable adornment names the worldly attraction that competes for the gaze.
Granted ornament returns adornment without making it the object that abandons companions.
Literal gold preserves rather than suppresses material beauty.
Worn covering makes the relocated adornment embodied and received.

structural_cues: 18:28 twice names wanting, restrains the eyes from worldly adornment, and keeps the addressee with worshippers; 18:30-31 then grants visible adornment to faithful doers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gaze, desire, rejected worldly adornment, and later granted adornment; I infer a retraining and relocation of desire, while the live alternative is a simpler temporal contrast between forbidden present luxury and permitted future luxury.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse simply compensates renunciation with greater luxury.
changed_reading.after: It does not reject beauty; it detaches beauty from status-seeking gaze and returns it as a gift that no longer displaces faithful companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The enclosing pavilion, injurious water, unwilling drink, and evil resting utility of 18:29 are answered by sheltered garden, flowing rivers, covering, and good resting utility in 18:31; the same service categories reverse from capture and assault to supply and care.

activation_trace.role: Overwhelming enclosure supplies the punitive direction of the first environment.
The surrounding pavilion gives punitive enclosure an architectural form.
Literal water supplies a bodily need that the hostile environment answers destructively.
Water drunk with aversion makes offered hospitality injurious.
The utility or resting-place branch is explicitly judged bad in the negative mirror.
The tree-sheltered garden reverses enclosure into habitation.
Abundant coursing water reverses harmful drink into sustaining environment.
Covering now protects and adorns rather than traps.
The same useful-rest branch is explicitly judged good in the positive mirror.

structural_cues: 18:29 closes `بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَاءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا`; 18:31 closes `نِعْمَ ٱلثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا`, with water and enclosure elaborated in both scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched enclosure, water, and resting-place categories; I infer a designed counter-environment whose services reverse direction, while the live alternative is that the scenes are only rhetorical opposites without a shared hospitality mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Punishment and reward are contrasting inventories.
changed_reading.after: They are counter-hospitality systems: one surrounds, serves, and supports in order to injure, while the other shelters, supplies, and supports in order to sustain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The no-loss wage promise precedes the focus, the wealthy owner later projects a better return for himself, and the ending assigns better recompense and outcome to divine authority; the focus's clothing/reward root-pair materializes the authorized rather than self-certified return.

activation_trace.role: Non-loss blocks righteous action from vanishing before it returns.
Wage for work supplies the explicit transactional entitlement.
Doing good supplies the action whose preserved return is promised.
Destination and return expose the owner's competing self-authored forecast.
Returned recompense at the close reassigns the standard of better return.
Final outcome tests a forecast by its actual end rather than present appearance.
The focus names recompense as what returns to its doer.
The paired clothing branch gives that authorized return material form.

structural_cues: 18:30 immediately promises that the good worker's wage will not be lost; 18:36 gives the owner his own forecast of a better return; 18:44 closes with better reward and outcome under divine authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preserved wage, a self-projected return, and the final better recompense/outcome; I infer that the focus scene is an adjudicated return placed between claim and verdict, while the live alternative treats these as separate reward formulas.

changed_reading.before: The reward is generic payment for belief and good work.
changed_reading.after: It is a lossless, authorized return of the deed to its doer, distinguished from wealth's unsupported prediction that it guarantees its own favorable return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parable's owned garden can have a river burst through it, be declared imperishable, lose its water into depth, and collapse; continuous flow and settled utility therefore distinguish the focus garden by maintained provision rather than by amplified estate assets.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and emergence supply the private garden's dramatic but contingent water source.
The same literal river image makes the two gardens materially comparable.
Perishing names the failure the owner wrongly excludes from his estate.
Water descending beyond reach reveals supply withdrawal beneath the visible garden.
Collapse converts productive architecture into failed support.
Enduring provision marks focus flow as maintained rather than accidentally possessed.
Staying in place supplies the stable habitation absent from the collapsed estate.
Continuing utility, not visible yield alone, defines the good destination.

structural_cues: 18:32-33 builds a productive, irrigated private garden; 18:35 voices its supposed permanence; 18:40-42 removes surface stability, water, fruit, and trellis support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies materially similar gardens with opposite supply histories; I infer that secure relation to the giver, not garden substance, causes permanence, while the live alternative is a simpler contrast between earthly transience and afterlife duration.

changed_reading.before: The focus garden is an indefinitely larger and richer version of the earthly estate.
changed_reading.after: It is an anti-estate: its decisive good is non-withdrawn flow and stable use, not abundance treated as self-owned evidence of permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failed owner has no faction able to support him, then governance and protective allegiance are assigned to God; reclining, companionship, and a good support-place render that reliable patronage as bodily ease.

activation_trace.role: Aid and making-victorious name the support the isolated owner lacks.
Taking charge supplies the reliable governing support that replaces the failed faction.
Protective allegiance supplies the social relation behind that support.
Reclining makes reliance on support visible in bodily posture.
Companionship carries the support mechanism from furniture into social relation.
Elbow-rest and leaning retain the mechanism's literal bodily anchor.

structural_cues: 18:43 denies the ruined owner any supporting faction or self-victory; 18:44 immediately assigns true governance to God, while 18:31 portrays plural recipients at supported rest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed social aid, divine governance, companionship, and bodily leaning; I infer a cross-domain support relation, while the live alternative keeps the couches as literal comfort with no patronage implication.

changed_reading.after: Reclining enacts secure dependence: the recipients can release self-support because their bodily, social, and governing support no longer fails.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads spatial engineering across separate scenes; it remains anchored in explicit below/above language and branch-backed collapse, roof, reclining, and couch images. Render it as a structural echo, not as a claim that the two constructions are lexical equivalents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `مِن تَحْتِهِم` and `مُتَّكِئِينَ ... عَلَى ٱلْأَرَائِكِ` specify a stable below/above arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Turning something off its face supplies inversion at the ruined estate.
Falling and collapse supply structural failure.
Raised roof or trellis supplies the failed load-bearing layer.
The explicit lower direction places provision stably beneath the recipients.
Reclining transfers weight without collapse.
The furnished couch supplies a successful elevated bearer.

changed_reading.before: The river and couches are independent comforts.
changed_reading.after: They form a successful load path: provision runs below and support bears above, reversing the estate that falls inward upon its own raised structure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the premature-cutting branch is distant from an ordinary color adjective; it remains anchored in `خُضْرًا` and is sharpened by the nearby ripe fruit and collapsed garden. Render it only as a material analogy of arrested decay, never as the lexical meaning of the phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The garments are specifically `خُضْرًا` (17), inside a focus scene of continuing flow and repose.

activation_trace.role: Taking vegetation while still green supplies the threshold before ripening and decay.
Flourishing ease keeps that threshold positively alive rather than merely immature.
Ripe fruit supplies the nearby commodity endpoint of vegetal growth.
The garden's later collapse supplies the decay endpoint from which focus greenness is withheld.

changed_reading.before: Green is a pleasing garment color.
changed_reading.after: Green can also image vitality held before the perishability of ripened assets: freshness becomes wearable and does not pass into the estate's decay cycle.

strongest_changes: The `ثياب`/`ثواب` root-pair makes reward a returned condition worn and inhabited.
18:29 and 18:31 become hostile and beneficent hospitality systems with inverted enclosure, water, and support.
The collapsing estate recasts the focus garden as non-withdrawn provision rather than amplified private wealth.
The ending lets bodily support carry an exploratory image of reliable divine patronage.
summary.what_was_special: One focus verse organizes material detail as return, enclosure, flow, and support; nearby context repeatedly reverses those mechanisms rather than merely adding thematic contrast.
remaining_uncertainties: The social-patronage reading of reclining depends on a cross-domain support analogy.
The green-as-preserved-freshness outlier is branch-distant and must not replace the ordinary color reading.
The packet supplies no branch inventory for `عَدْن`, so permanence remains a structural inference supported by cited flow, residence, and collapse contrasts.
